name: Parameters.placeClass_placeOfInt
summary: ν prime to N₀(P) is prime to N₁(P, s) = N₀(P)·3^c·2^s (2, 3 ∣ N₀(P)), so placeOfInt(P, s, ν) is the place of ν mod N₁(P, s), whose reduction is ν mod m.

steps.claim: ν is a unit mod N₁(P, s) (coprime to N₀(P), and to 2 and 3, which divide N₀(P)), so placeOfInt(P, s, ν) = placeMulEquiv(P, s)⁻¹(ν mod N₁(P, s)), and placeClass(P, d) (d the proof of m ∣ N₁(P, s)) reduces it to the class of ν in ℤ/m.
steps.lean:
simp (disch := grind [Parameters, h.symm.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left]) [placeClass, placeOfInt,
    unitsMap_val, towerDeg, coe_int_isUnit_iff_isCoprime, mul_left_iff, IsCoprime.pow_left, h.symm]
